scope: Selected rice provisions checked against primary texts, not an exhaustive market-compliance assessment.
eu_basis: Article 2(3): food as placed on the market and its edible part unless otherwise specified. Article 3: justified processing/dilution/ingredient factors where no specific maximum exists.
nickel_transition: Article 10(1)(p): food lawfully placed on the market before 2026-07-01 may remain until minimum-durability/use-by date; operator bears proof under Article 10(3).
conversion: mg/kg × 1000 = µg/kg; no cooking, moisture or reconstitution conversion.

records.material: rice, quinoa, wheat bran, and wheat gluten
records.basis: Rice commodity; as placed on the market.
Non-parboiled milled rice; as placed on the market.
records.table_label: EU · Non-parboiled white rice · inorganic arsenic

records.material: parboiled rice, husked rice, rice flour
records.basis: Separate grain and flour categories; as placed on the market.
records.table_label: EU · Parboiled or husked rice; rice flour · inorganic arsenic
records.table_text: 250 µg/kg (0.25 mg/kg). Separate entries: Annex I 3.4.1.2 and 3.4.1.3.

records.material: rice destined for production of food for infants and young children

records.basis: Drink as placed on the market; not uncooked grain or moisture-free dry matter.
records.table_label: EU · Non-alcoholic rice-based drinks · inorganic arsenic
records.table_text: 30 µg/kg (0.030 mg/kg). Drink scope; Annex I 3.4.1.6.

records.table_label: EU · Rice other than husked rice · nickel

records.basis: As placed on the market; applies from 2026-07-01.

records.material: all types of infant rice cereals

limitations: Selected EU and US provisions only; no complete analyte or all-jurisdiction search.
A matching occurrence statistic cannot establish lot compliance.

chemical_treatment_rule.claim: Covered food must not be deliberately detoxified by chemical treatments.
